description: G 55 2: the blocks 1.. cut into pieces for the ranks. A closed wavy channel of three blocks of 48 x 12 cells in a row, block 1 turned by 90 deg (cut along its j: more cells in j, no open faces), block 2 by 180 deg (cut along i), dam breaks in blocks 1 and 2, non-hydrostatic, one refinement level in static boxes over the cuts, two ranks: 5 blocks (pieces of 12 x 24 and 24 x 12), the interfaces of the pieces composed with the turned interfaces of DIVEMesh. Without G 55 the same solution to 2e-12 (the pressure solve); hydrostatic to round-off (Dropbox Tagus_NHFLOW_multiblock/validation/03_block_pieces).
covers: geo_mesh::split_blocks (pieces, nodes, interfaces cell by cell, the check), face_piece
reefamr::blocks_setup with the pieces as blocks: placement, fills, patches across the cuts
